title: Describe your home
prompt: Write 3 or 4 sentences about your home. Say where it is and what rooms it has.
model: I live in a small house in Mogadishu. It has three rooms and a kitchen.
promptSo: Qor 3 ama 4 jumladood oo ku saabsan gurigaaga. Sheeg halka uu ku yaal iyo qolalka uu ka kooban yahay.
modelSo: Waxaan ku noolahay guri yar oo ku yaal Muqdisho. Wuxuu leeyahay saddex qol iyo jiko.

title: A good friend
prompt: Write a paragraph about a good friend. Say who they are, what they like, and why you like them. Use because.
model: My friend Hodan is kind and funny. She likes music, and she cooks very well. I like her because she always helps me.
promptSo: Qor faqrado ka hadlaya saaxiib wanaagsan. Sheeg qofka uu yahay, waxa uu jecel yahay iyo sababta aad u jeceshahay. Adeegso “sababtoo ah”.
modelSo: Saaxiibtay Hodan waa qof naxariis badan oo kaftan badan. Waxay jeceshahay muusigga, si fiicanna ayay wax u karisaa. Waxaan u jeclahay sababtoo ah mar walba way i caawisaa.

title: Is social media good for young people?
prompt: Write a paragraph giving your opinion. Give two reasons and use however.
model: In my opinion, social media is useful because it helps young people stay in touch. However, it can waste time.
promptSo: Qor faqrado aad ku cabbirayso ra’yigaaga. Bixi laba sababood, kuna dar erayga “hase yeeshee”.
modelSo: Aragtidayda, baraha bulshada waa waxtar sababtoo ah waxay dhalinyarada ka caawiyaan inay xiriirka ilaashadaan. Hase yeeshee, waxay sidoo kale lumin karaan waqtiga.

title: Reply to a meeting invitation
prompt: Write a formal email accepting a meeting on Thursday at 10 a.m. Start with Dear and end with Regards. Ask if you should bring any documents.
model: Dear Ms Ali, Thank you for the invitation. I am happy to confirm the meeting on Thursday at 10 a.m. Should I bring any documents? Regards, Omar
promptSo: Qor iimayl rasmi ah oo aad ku aqbalayso martiqaadka kulan Khamiista saacadda 10-ka subaxnimo. Ku bilow Dear kuna dhammee Regards. Weydii haddii ay tahay inaad keento dukumentiyo.
modelSo: Marwo Cali, Waad ku mahadsan tahay martiqaadka. Waxaan ku faraxsanahay inaan xaqiijiyo kulanka Khamiista saacadda 10-ka subaxnimo. Ma jiraan dukumentiyo ay tahay inaan keeno? Salaan wanaagsan, Cumar.

title: A complaint letter
prompt: Write a formal email to complain about a late delivery. State the problem, say what you expect, and set a deadline. Start with Dear and end with Yours sincerely.
model: Dear Sir or Madam, I am writing to complain about my order, which arrived two weeks late. I would like a refund by Friday. Yours sincerely, A. Hassan
promptSo: Qor iimayl rasmi ah oo cabasho ah oo ku saabsan alaab dib u dhacday. Sheeg dhibaatada, waxa aad filayso in la sameeyo, iyo waqti kama dambays ah. Ku bilow Dear kuna dhammee Yours sincerely.
modelSo: Mudane ama Marwo, Waxaan idiin soo qorayaa inaan ka cabto dalabkaygii oo yimid laba toddobaad ka dib waqtigii loogu talagalay. Waxaan codsanayaa in lacagta la ii soo celiyo ugu dambayn Jimcaha. Ixtiraam badan, A. Xasan.

title: Should cities ban cars from centres?
prompt: Write an essay of at least 150 words. Introduce the topic, give arguments for and against, and conclude. Use linking words such as moreover and in conclusion.
model: Many cities are considering banning cars from their centres. Moreover, ... In conclusion, ...
promptSo: Qor maqaal ugu yaraan 150 eray ah. Soo bandhig mawduuca, ka hadal doodaha taageersan iyo kuwa ka soo horjeeda, dabadeedna gunaanad samee. Adeegso erayo isku xira sida “weliba” iyo “gabagabadii”.
modelSo: Magaalooyin badan ayaa ka fiirsanaya inay baabuurta ka mamnuucaan bartamaha magaalada. Weliba, ... Gabagabadii, ...

title: A short progress report
prompt: Write a short professional report (at least 120 words) on a project that is behind schedule. Include the cause, the impact and two recommendations.
model: This report summarises the status of the project... The delay is due to... We recommend...
promptSo: Qor warbixin xirfadeed oo gaaban (ugu yaraan 120 eray) oo ku saabsan mashruuc jadwalkiisii ka dib dhacay. Ku dar sababta, saamaynta iyo laba talo-bixin.
modelSo: Warbixintani waxay soo koobaysaa xaaladda mashruuca... Dib u dhacu wuxuu ka dhashay... Waxaan ku talinaynaa...

title: A cover letter
prompt: Write a cover letter for a marketing assistant role. Explain your relevant experience and why you want the job. Start with Dear and end with Yours faithfully or Regards.
model: Dear Hiring Manager, I am writing to apply for the position of Marketing Assistant. ...
promptSo: Qor warqad codsi shaqo oo ku saabsan jagada kaaliye suuq-geyn. Sharax khibraddaada ku habboon iyo sababta aad shaqadan u rabto. Ku bilow Dear kuna dhammee Yours faithfully ama Regards.
modelSo: Maareeyaha Shaqaaleysiinta, Waxaan warqaddan ku codsanayaa jagada Kaaliyaha Suuq-geynta. ...

title: Language and identity
prompt: Write a reflective essay (at least 200 words) on whether language shapes the way we think. Take a clear position, anticipate a counter-argument and respond to it.
model: Although the strong version of linguistic relativity has been disputed... Nevertheless...
promptSo: Qor maqaal milicsi ah oo ugu yaraan 200 eray ah kuna saabsan in luqaddu qaabayso habka aan u fikirno iyo in kale. Si cad u muuji mowqifkaaga, saadaali dood lid kugu ah, dabadeedna uga jawaab.
modelSo: Inkasta oo aragtida xooggan ee xiriirka luqadda iyo fikirka la dood geliyey... Si kastaba ha ahaatee...
